description: This file contains implementation of functions related to setting up and retrieving a service over a virtual socket (vsock) using Android's binder IPC mechanism. It defines functions to start a RPC server and to get a service client connection.

methods.name: setupRpcServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts a RPC server over a vsock connection on a specified port, and registers a service named 'TestService'.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Creates and returns a client connection to a service over a vsock, given a CID and port.
